data.rationale: The proposed workflow matches the true one in goal, order and the key parameters (item, both quotes, supplier city). It differs in a few ways. It splits each quote into amount and currency parameters. It lists a "recipient" parameter even though the recipient is fixed. It ends with "Send or discard" when the true workflow requires Discard and never Send. It also puts the body format in terms of currencies and a time zone, which differs slightly from the true body, and it adds a UI navigation step that may not match the real tabs. These are minor to moderate flaws, and the spec could still be automated with some fixes.
